title: Enhancing Pre-Training Data Detection via Multi-Layer Concentration Analysis in Large Language Models

contributions.purpose: 突破仅用末层输出的预训练数据检测
contributions.mechanism: 从早/中/晚层(1/4、1/2、3/4 深度)抽取概率分布,分析跨层记忆‘浓度’特征
contributions.evaluation: 定性框架(权重 0.3/0.4/0.3,中层最高);Pythia 因实现受限仅用简化末层特征
contributions.domain: LLM 记忆/成员推断/预训练数据检测
contributions.source_quote: We introduce Multi-Layer Concentration Analysis, a comprehensive framework that captures how probability distributions evolve and concentrate across multiple network layers.

contributions.purpose: 用分布形状特征刻画记忆
contributions.mechanism: 计算 Shannon 熵、Gini 系数、top-k 浓度、有效词表大小,归一化后与 Min-K%++ 按自适应权重 α 融合
contributions.evaluation: 主实验 α=0.6;消融却称 α=0.5 更优(见 notes)
contributions.source_quote: we fuse these multi-layer signatures with Min-K++ using adaptive weighting.

contributions.mechanism: WikiMIA 基准上对 Pythia-2.8b 与 Mamba-1.4b 评测
contributions.evaluation: 最高 70.3% AUROC;Mamba 128-token 68.4→70.3(+1.9pp);Pythia 提升 0-1.0pp,状态空间模型获益更大
contributions.source_quote: state-space models like Mamba exhibit distinct multi-layer memorization signatures that can be leveraged for superior detection, while transformers show more modest improvements.

self_declared_provenance.quote: Our method maintains the theoretical foundations of Min-K%++ while significantly expanding the scope of distributional analysis.

notes: 数据红旗:头条数字前后不一致——摘要写 Mamba 128-token‘1.9 percentage point gains’,贡献(3)却写‘2.4 percentage point improvements for Mamba’,结论又回‘up to 1.9pp’,Figure 1 caption 写‘up to 2.4pp’;Table 1 实测 68.4→70.3=1.9pp,故 2.4pp 无据。方法对 transformer 近乎无效:Pythia‘Ours’在 len32/64 与基线 AUROC 完全相同(64.4=64.4、63.8=63.8),因 Pythia‘用简化末层特征 due to implementation constraints’,多层主张实际只在 Mamba 成立。α 后见之明:主实验用 α=0.6 但消融称 α=0.5 最优。trade-off:Mamba128 的 TPR05 反降 10.1→5.0(变差)。统计:只跑一次、无误差棒(自认);算力仅‘single GPU ~40GB’。全 AI 生成(checklist 全 [D]),且自认‘难在无基准论文下做原创研究’,增量性强。reject。
